text: In story writing, there was a really famous concept known as the bomb under the table. The idea is that if you were watching a scene of some people eating dinner at a kitchen table and a bomb went off all of a sudden, you would be shocked and surprised. But if you, as the audience, were shown the bomb beforehand and left the characters at the table unaware of its existence, you would introduce an element of suspense to the story. So the trade-off for the shocking moment of the explosion is all the tension that builds up leading to that final explosion. The audience knows something crazy is coming. They just don't know when. That being said, The Drake Bell cameo was peak.

text:
Twilight Sparkle is the central main character of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She is a female unicorn pony who transforms into an Alicorn and becomes a princess in Magical Mystery Cure. She is also the daughter of Twilight Velvet and Night Light, the younger sister of Shining Armor, sister-in-law to Princess Cadance, and paternal aunt to Flurry Heart.

At the beginning of the series, Twilight and Spike move from their residence in Canterlot to the Golden Oak Library in Ponyville to study the magic of friendship, and in Twilight's Kingdom - Part 2, she gains her own castle along with the title "Princess of Friendship". She represents the element of magic.

Before becoming a princess, Twilight regularly sends friendship reports to Princess Celestia. In Owl's Well That Ends Well, she adopts a pet owl named Owlowiscious. As of The Last Problem, she is the ruler of Equestria.

Twilight's human counterpart, Sci-Twi, briefly serves as an antagonist in My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games.

text:
Love the implication that Trixie, Twilight, and/or Marionette's just been biting ponies and that's why Ponywolves and Vamponies are just kinda a thing now. Didn't kill them all exactly one time and now they've gotten out, and are infesting equestria, making the lives of anyone who doesn't want to look at them or think about their existence worse.

Truly, Celestia is a kind and merciful monarch for building a reeducation center to round them all up, instead of just incinerating all of ponyville and starting over for so horribly and selfishly having its legal residents exist in her line of sight.
(Which I'm sure is 100% intentional on her part and had nothing to do with the fact she banished all three ponies with resurrection abilities to an alternate dimension for at least a couple more episodes without thinking of the consequences. Nope she's just nice that's totally the reason she's not killing literally everyone again.)

also how did I not clock Bell was trans until seconds before he mentioned deadnaming. I'm normally better then this. Like I'm still worse then the average straight person at clocking that but my gaydar is only dysfunctional not nonexistent. I know he was bone before testosterone and no one told him about it so he'd stay cute and effeminate but still

Comedically unclear but aside, I actually really enjoy the relationship Bell and Sky have, completely seriously. It's already fairly unique, with both of them being former love-triangle rivals that outlived the object of their affection, but on top of that, they both became immortals in entirely different ways and lived independent lives for hundreds of years apart, before finding themselves together again somehow in the modern age.
It legitimately has the underscores of classical, late 1800s/early 1900s fantasy, but in a modern style, and that genuinely enthralls me more then any hot vampire letting me drink their blood could.

I've probably said this before, but I'm genuinely so glad I found you and your work, tamers, it's genuinely inspiring, and your creativity with story and engaging relationships between characters are something to be admired, even if it's "just" for a silly MLP parody series, instead of something "serious" and "proper." 



Also shout-out to Shining, he continues to be the shining beacon of moral good in the worst decade in equestrian history; Femboy discovered he had a second daughter, and within three minutes had not only taken more responsibility then 99% of equestrian fathers, but also beat her racist bully half to death. 
We should all aspire to be Shining. Mainly because of the Femboy bit but also he's just kinda cool like that.

Also Also Dragon flawless is doing things to me

Dragon fractured too but those things are less hot to maybe send help
